---
title: "TangleLatex-Parabel mit Shiny for Python"
format: html
server: shiny
---

Ziehe eine der farbigen Zahlen in der Formel horizontal. Die durchgezogene Kurve folgt den aktuellen Werten, die gestrichelte zeigt die Werte vor dem Ziehen.

```{python}
#| context: setup
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from shiny import reactive, render, ui
from shinywidgets import output_widget, reactive_read, render_widget
from wigglystuff import TangleLatex

XS = np.linspace(-5, 5, 201)
```

```{python}
#| output: false
@reactive.calc
def tangle_widget():
    return TangleLatex(
        latex=r"y = \tangle{a}x^2 + \tangle{b}x + \tangle{c}",
        parameters={
            "a": {"value": 1.5, "min_value": -5, "max_value": 5, "step": 0.1, "digits": 1},
            "b": {"value": -2, "min_value": -10, "max_value": 10, "step": 0.5, "digits": 1},
            "c": {"value": 0.5, "min_value": -5, "max_value": 5, "step": 0.1, "digits": 1},
        },
        theme="light",
    )


@render_widget
def tangle():
    return tangle_widget()


@render.plot
def parabola():
    values = reactive_read(tangle_widget(), "values")
    committed = reactive_read(tangle_widget(), "committed_values")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))
    ax.plot(XS, committed["a"] * XS**2 + committed["b"] * XS + committed["c"],
            ls="--", color="#246bce", label="vorher")
    ax.plot(XS, values["a"] * XS**2 + values["b"] * XS + values["c"],
            color="#246bce", lw=2, label="aktuell")
    ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.8)
    ax.axvline(0, color="grey", lw=0.8)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax.legend()
    return fig
```

```{python}
#| context: ui
ui.layout_columns(
    output_widget("tangle"),
    ui.output_plot("parabola"),
    col_widths=[6, 6],
)
```
